patches.title: After Placement Avoid Look
patches.principle: After placing an object, do not use 'look' or 'examine'. Proceed directly to the next required action.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after a successful move action.

patches.title: Return to Source for Second
patches.principle: After placing the first of two identical objects, return to the exact location where you found it to search for the second.
patches.when_to_apply: When one of two required objects has been placed.

patches.title: Clean Without Detour
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, go straight to sink, clean, then go straight to destination. No intermediate steps.
patches.when_to_apply: When you are holding a dirty object that must be cleaned and then placed.
